question:
Which part of the following sentence contains a spelling error? 

The author's penchant (1) for archiac diction (2) often obfuscated (3) the text's underlying message (4).
solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. archiac .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "archiac" in the sentence is spelled incorrectly.
 
• The correct spelling is "archaic," which means "old-fashioned" or "belonging to an earlier period."
 
• Spelling errors can change the meaning of the sentence or make the text difficult to understand.

Correct sentence: *The author’s penchant for **archaic** diction often obfuscated the text’s underlying message*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Common spelling mistakes to watch out for:**
 
 
• "Definately" → Correct: "Definitely"
 
• "Seperate" → Correct: "Separate"
 
• "Occured" → Correct: "Occurred"
 
 
 
• **Importance of correct spelling:**
 
 
• Ensures clarity and professional communication.
 
• Helps avoid misunderstandings in written texts.
